blocks.text: Methamphetamine (Meth) addiction is a very massive and significant drug-related problem not only in Canada but all over the world as well. It happens when a person develops tolerance to methyl amphetamine that actually develops rapidly. The effects of this drug is known to last for about 3 to 4 hours and extended use of meth can cause severe weight loss, exhaustion, insomnia, paranoid psychosis, dental problems, aggression, severe depression and skin problems. Smoking meth over long periods of time can lead to extreme psychotic episodes with auditory and visual hallucinations.

Methamphetamine is a kind of drug which is commonly smoked or injected. It has a long-lived and extra strong stimulating effect. Meth can be availed in the following form: clear liquid, pink/yellow/white powder, ampoules (meth), tiny whitish chips (ice). Most methamphetamine products are illicitly manufactured and they usually come with a questionable quality. Methamphetamine has the following street names: meth, speed, crank, ice, glass and crystal.

Authorities say that the addiction rate of this province is a little higher than the country’s overall average. A survey was conducted among teenagers in the province and it was found out that 4 percent of them have tried using meth. This is an indication that meth addiction is potential in BC and can cause a serious problem among concerned families and authorities. For your information, using this drug even just for once can immediately lead to methamphetamine addictio0n right away.
